description: Values mub6_karlsson_volume_cover.rs reads instead of computing them. None is evidence for any MUB(6) statement.

extension_psi_base_term.reason: Base term (81/100 - 1/6)^2 added to the triad defect in extension_psi_lower; it is not computed from the candidate basis box and does not depend on the parameter box, so every strictly-outside box passes psi_gap > 0. Feeds min_extension_psi_gap, outside_boxes_certified and complete in mub_karlsson_volume_cover.json.

box_verified_positive.reason: verified_positive on each certified box is written as true, not read from a separate check. Feeds boxes[].verified_positive in mub_karlsson_volume_cover.json.
